name: NASA POWER
licence: Freely available for public use by NASA. Not a formal open licence: NASA requests citation and notification rather than imposing licence terms.
attribution_text: "The data was obtained from NASA Langley Research Center's Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources (POWER) project funded through the NASA Earth Science Division."
limitations: Satellite and reanalysis derived; monthly blocks have processing lag. Not a substitute for a local weather station. Best used for seasonal and historical context, not for today's field decision.

name: Open-Meteo Air Quality API
limitations: Same non-commercial restriction as the forecast API. CAMS-based model output is coarse; not suitable for a field-level air quality claim.

name: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (ERA5)
limitations: Same non-commercial restriction as the forecast API.

name: Open-Meteo Forecast API
licence: CC-BY 4.0 (data); free API tier restricted to NON-COMMERCIAL use
limitations: Model output, not an official Indian meteorological product. Grid resolution is far coarser than a field, so this is a fallback and trend source, NOT the authority for warnings in India. CRITICAL COMMERCIAL RISK: the free tier is non-commercial only. If Aranya ever gains ads, subscriptions, or paid distribution, this adapter MUST be swapped for a paid plan or replaced. Tracked in docs/LICENCES.md.

name: OpenStreetMap Nominatim (geocoding)
limitations: Strict 1 req/s policy. Only usable for occasional place lookup, never for autocomplete on every keystroke, and never for bulk geocoding. Place names are transliterated to Latin script, so Indian script place names will need the user's own script and local-language administrative data alongside.
fallback: packaged India administrative boundary list (planned, offline; not yet a

name: OpenStreetMap Overpass API
limitations: The verified market query returned HTTP 200 with a well-formed response but an EMPTY `elements` array, so no OSM-tagged marketplaces matched that small test bounding box. That is a coverage finding, not a failure: OSM coverage of Indian agri infrastructure is uneven, so a result may be absent rather than negative. Shared public endpoints are not a production dependency.
fallback: a self-hosted or dedicated Overpass instance (not a registered source yet); official mandi lists from AGMARKNET for actual market locations.

name: data.gov.in - Current Daily Prices of Commodities (AGMARKNET dataset)
licence: Government Open Data Licence - India (GODL) for published datasets, per the portal footer.
attribution_text: Source: data.gov.in (ODL), dataset published by DMI
limitations: CONCRETE BLOCKER OBSERVED: `https://api.data.gov.in/` refused the TCP connection ("Connection refused") on 2026-10-10, while `https://data.gov.in/` (the HTML portal) responded HTTP 200 and displayed "The portal is undergoing maintenance". So the catalogue is up but the API gateway is not accepting connections from this network. An API key has also not been obtained. This is the cleanest licensing route for mandi prices and should be retried.

name: India Meteorological Department API
licence: Government of India content. Free for registered non-commercial users, but the precise terms text was NOT retrieved and must be read and recorded before use.
limitations: Probed unauthenticated endpoints returned HTTP 404 and the portal requires an account, so no data was retrieved. This is the authoritative Indian weather source and MUST be preferred over model data once an API key exists, but it cannot be built on until registration and terms are complete.
fallback: open_meteo_forecast (clearly labelled as non-official model output)

name: ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0
attribution_text: "Poggio, L., de Sousa, L. M., Batjes, N. H., Heuvelink, G. B. M., Kempen, B., Ribeiro, E., and Rossiter, D.: SoilGrids 2.0: producing soil information for the globe with quantified spatial uncertainty, SOIL, 7, 217-240, 2021."
limitations: TWO HARD CONSTRAINTS, both confirmed on 2026-10-10: (1) The numeric `properties/query` endpoint returned `{"layers": [... "values": {"mean": null}]}` or an empty `layers` array at every tested coordinate, while `classification/query` returned a real WRB class (e.g. "Luvisols") at the same point. SoilGrids' own documentation states the REST API is currently PAUSED with issues, so numeric soil values are NOT obtainable through it today. (2) ISRIC explicitly states SoilGrids "is a global model intended for global applications ... we do not advise to use SoilGrids at the local or farm level." Aranya must therefore NEVER present a SoilGrids value as a soil test result, and must never display it as a measured reading for a farmer's own field.
fallback: soil_health_card (restricted, field-level but manual); agricultural university lab records; not_integrated ICAR/NBSS&LUP sources in later stages.

name: OpenStreetMap tile servers (raster + vector)
licence: ODbL 1.0 (data); tile SERVICE use is governed by OSMF policy
limitations: DIRECT CONFLICT WITH ARANYA'S OFFLINE-FIRST GOAL, resolved deliberately: Aranya may display OSM tiles online with attribution, and MAY cache them according to HTTP cache headers, but it will NOT implement prefetch or ship an offline tile pack from OSMF servers. Offline maps in later stages must use a source that grants offline rights explicitly.
fallback: a vector tile package with explicit offline licensing, or a self-hosted tile stack (switch2osm.org guidance); neither is a registered source yet.

name: AGMARKNET (Directorate of Marketing and Inspection)
licence: UNCONFIRMED - no published licence or machine-readable terms located
attribution_text: Source: AGMARKNET, DMI, Government of India
limitations: The portal responded HTTP 200 but is an ASP.NET form interface with no public API. Any adapter would have to submit the search form, which is scraping unless permission is granted. Must NOT be scraped without written permission. Mandi prices are the highest-value feature for a farmer and also the most legally constrained; resolve terms before building anything on it.
fallback: enam (investigating), and state-level mandi price publications that publish explicit reuse terms.

name: Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA)
attribution_text: Source: APEDA, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
limitations: Reachable (HTTP 200). Export statistics are published as reports and spreadsheets.

name: ISRO Bhuvan
limitations: Reachable; WMS/tile services exist but usage terms are undocumented.

name: Ministry of Commerce and Industry
attribution_text: Source: Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India
limitations: Reachable (HTTP 200). Policy documents are HTML/PDF.

name: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (Sentinel)
licence: Copernicus Sentinel data is free, full and open access under EU law with no express or implied warranty of quality or suitability.
attribution_text: "Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (year), processed by Aranya."
limitations: The catalogue OData path returned HTTP 404 at `/odata/v1/Products` while the STAC endpoint `/stac/collections` returned HTTP 200 with a full collection list. Catalogue access works; the OData path needs the correct route. Real constraint is size: Sentinel imagery is hundreds of MB per scene, which is incompatible with the small-footprint goal. Stage 01 must NOT bundle imagery. Aranya must carry the "Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data" credit.

name: Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT)
licence: UNCONFIRMED. Government of India portal; no machine-readable licence found. The root URL answered HTTP 200 with a meta-refresh redirect page.
attribution_text: Source: DGFT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
limitations: Reachable but the landing page is a redirect stub. DGFT notifications are HTML/PDF documents, not structured data. Policy features must link to the official notice and must never paraphrase a legal instrument loosely.

name: National Agricultural Market (eNAM)
limitations: Reachable, but terms and any API are unconfirmed.

name: ISRO Bhoonidhi
licence: UNCONFIRMED - ISRO/NRSC portal; no published licence located
limitations: Reachable and India-specific, which makes it strategically better than Copernicus for Indian crops, but there is no documented API and no licence text. Account required.

name: Soil Health Card Portal (Government of India)
licence: UNCONFIRMED - Government of India portal; no machine-readable licence found
attribution_text: Source: Soil Health Card, Government of India
limitations: Portal reachable, but there is no documented API and no licence was located. Automation risks violating terms and the records are farm-level personal data. Field-level laboratory values are the single most valuable soil input for Aranya and this remains the key open question for Stage 02.
fallback: the farmer enters their own Soil Health Card result (manual entry needs no redistribution of government records); this is not a registered source.

name: Department of Agriculture and Cooperation (DAC)
limitations: FAILED VERIFICATION. `agricoop.nic.in` did not resolve in DNS on 2026-10-10. The Department was restructured into the Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare; the successor domain must be identified in Stage 02.

name: Directorate of Economics and Statistics - crop production statistics
attribution_text: Source: DES, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
limitations: FAILED VERIFICATION. `des.gov.in` and `www.des.gov.in` did not resolve in DNS ("No address associated with hostname") on 2026-10-10 from this network. The host may be genuinely retired, renamed, or blocked on this network; that was not determined. Crop production statistics therefore have no working source. Alternative hosts to test in Stage 02: mospi.gov.in, pib.gov.in press releases, and the MoSPI National Accounts "Farmgate value" series.

name: ICAR / NBSS&LUP Indian soil resources
limitations: Not assessed in Stage 01. Candidate for India-specific soil grouping.

name: Kisan Suvidha / Farmer Portal
limitations: Reachable on 2026-10-10; terms not yet assessed.
fallback: the farmer portal of the Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
limitations: Not probed in Stage 01. Identified as the most likely successor source after the DES DNS failure. Needs probing before any production-statistics feature.
